summary: Agent 0.33.1: probe-identity instrument fixes after its first run on a node. The rights check no longer needs the configuration (it is unreadable for the restricted tokens), CUDA counts only on a proof (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES in Ollama's config line gave a false 'seen'), and the probe observes up to 60 s after health for CUDA and GPU memory. No change to how the service runs.

findings.evidence: First node run (0.33.0): rights check under restricted/localservice failed with 'configuration: Access is denied'; 'cuda seen' for children that had failed; VRAM 0 even for the system baseline.
findings.resolution: Second node run (0.33.1, same node): rights results for all three tokens; failed children show 'not seen'; STT under system shows its CUDA ready line and 2076 MiB, matching the running service. Unit tests for the CUDA reading cover the environment-variable line, an announcement and the ready line.

tests.command: go test ./... (Windows, Linux/WSL), go vet, gofmt
tests.evidence: ok; probe tests incl. the new CUDA cases and the stand-in child.

tests.command: probe-identity 0.33.1 on a Windows node as LocalSystem
tests.evidence: system: stt healthy, CUDA seen, 2076 MiB; ollama healthy, CUDA seen. restricted: stt exit 0xC06D007E, ollama cannot traverse its model folder, NVML init rc 9. localservice: stt log folder not writable, ollama model folder not traversable, NVML set rc 4; process paths ~21 of 666, user hives 0 of 1.

limitations: Ollama's GPU memory is 0 without a loaded model; loading one is not part of the probe.
